howItWorks.title: From a first hello to a bond that lasts
howItWorks.description: Three small steps. No algorithms, no noise — just people talking.

step1.title: Show up as you are
step1.description: Create your profile and tell the community what you love to talk about.

step2.title: Tune into real voices
step2.description: Listen to live conversations and join the rooms that feel like yours.

step3.title: Grow a real bond
step3.description: Share time, knowledge and things with people who value the same as you.

features.title: Built for conversations, not for scrolling
features.description: Every decision starts with one question: does this bring people closer?

feature1.title: Audio first
feature1.description: Real voices and live rooms instead of endless feeds.

feature2.title: True bonds
feature2.description: Connections built on trust and reciprocity, never on reach.

feature3.title: Equality at the center
feature3.description: Everyone arrives with the same voice and the same rights.

feature4.title: Shared reality
feature4.description: Culture is made together, one conversation at a time.

cta.title: Your next bond starts with a conversation
cta.description: Join the community, open the mic and let a real conversation surprise you.
